name: Strata Critical Medical Inc. Class A Common Stock
summary: Strata Critical Medical, Inc. is dedicated to supporting healthcare providers throughout the United States by offering swift logistical management and specialized medical assistance. A significant part of their operations involves the movement of human organs for transplant, utilizing both aerial and ground transportation methods. Founded in 2014, the organization previously operated under the name Blade Air Mobility, Inc. and is set to officially change its name to Strata Critical Medical, Inc. in August of 2025. Its primary corporate office is located in New York, New York.
